title: Represent actual classes as exact disjoint boxes and integer-lattice cosets
statement: Fix the accepted E0C conservative complex-balanced network Theta. Paid finite preprocessing stores its hierarchy, core and single-coordinate backward-coverability bases, physical normalization words and actual integer-lattice HNF/Smith data. Threshold comparisons locate a core or a coordinate bounded throughout the entire class, descending at most d times. At a core node, a stored predecessor witness and control-tree word normalize x to z=x+delta_j with a fixed integral offset. A candidate y belongs to Gamma(x0) exactly when it respects ancestral bounded coordinates, belongs to the same control component, covers the core, and z(y)-z0 belongs to the actual lattice L. Buffered Graver words give the converse without saturation. Partition each free coordinate at the finitely many coverability thresholds. On each resulting disjoint box, control tests and deterministic first-witness choice are constant, so class membership is precisely y in z0-delta_j+L, or empty. Truncate at 0<=y_i<=floor((w.x0)/w_i), exactly justified by conservation. Thus every actual class has a disjoint fixed-finite box/coset representation with O_Theta(1+bitlength(x0)) description and polynomial variable-bit membership work. Fixed preprocessing may be enormous but is computable and paid; no uniform polynomial-network-input compiler follows. General affine-stratification existence is mature Miller1009.2199v2 capital, not claimed new. The representation does not compute factorial-weight piece masses, normalization or the full binary-time sampler.
